Function Documentation

HxResult HxProgressBarDelete ( HxProgressBar_t *  pProgressBar  ) 

Delete a progressbar widget.

HxProgressBarDelete deletes a progressbar created from an earlier call to HxProgressBarNew.

It is not necessary to call this function when quitting the application, since the widget's parent calls this function just before the parent is deleted. HxProgressBarDelete only needs to be called when deleting a progressbar at runtime.

Parameters:
pProgressBar IN: Pointer to the progressbar to delete
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

HxResult HxProgressBarNew ( uint32_t  id,
HxWidget_t *  pParent,
const HxRectangle_t *  pBounds,
int32_t  maxValue,
HxProgressBar_t **  hProgressBar 
)

Create a progressbar widget.

HxProgressBarNew creates a new progressbar widget. The application is responsible for defining the bounds of the progressbar. If zero is passed for the bounds height, the progress bar will use the default height (14 pixels).

The default system color is used if pColor is NULL.

Parameters:
id IN: Unique ID for the widget, defined by app, or kHxWidgetAutoID to auto-generate the ID
pParent IN: Pointer to "parent" widget containing label
pBounds IN: Pointer to the bounds
maxValue IN: MaxValue progressbar represent
hProgressBar OUT: Handle to the new progressbar; *hProgressBar is NULL on failure
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful. Returns HX_MEMORY_ERROR if memory allocation fails, and sets *hProgressBar to NULL.
